thread:
Alex (Marketing): heads up — we have the press dry run for the launch livestream tomorrow 09:30 PT. need to confirm briefing rooming + embargo cascade.
Julia (PR): noted. who's running the script? i'll take host brief + talking points.
Sam (Product): i'll do the quick demo segment, 5–7 mins. can someone confirm the demo environment is stable?
Ravi (Ops): demo env is scheduled for a smoke test at 07:30 PT. will post results to #release-war-room.
Alex (Marketing): perfect. Julia — we need final quote language for the exec by 18:00 PT today. legal signoff required.
Nina (Legal): i can review but need the exact quote strings. please inline the three variants (short, technical, and press-friendly).
Julia (PR): sending drafts now: 
- short: "Redwood Inference makes LLM inference predictable at scale."
- technical: "Our serving runtime and smart-routing reduce tail latency and lower token costs across deployments."
- press: "Redwood Inference helps companies run LLMs faster and cheaper whether hosted, dedicated, or private."
Nina (Legal): quick comments: avoid comparative language like "cheaper" without sourcing. suggest: "helps companies reduce inference latency and cost." approve after that tweak.
Julia (PR): updated. adding parenthetical stat: "up to 30% lower per-token cost in our benchmark" — who owns benchmark numbers?
Sam (Product): bench team owns it — @Ravi can route the official bench PDF. baseline vs. open baseline config is in drive.
Ravi (Ops): uploading bench PDF to drive: https://drive.company/launch/bench_v2.pdf. Use the exact phrasing from slide 6.
Alex (Marketing): timeline: 18:00 PT quote final -> legal signoff by 19:00 -> embargo note out to analysts 20:00 PT (dry run attendees only).
Julia (PR): for embargo cascade: i'll ping top 8 analysts + press list. do we want a separate briefing for EMEA/APAC?
Sam (Product): yes — we'll run two live briefings: 1) Americas at launch, 2) EMEA/APAC follow-up 24 hrs later. prepare a brief Q&A doc for both.
Alex (Marketing): good. Draft Q&A: include common questions on dedicated/private deployment pricing, security (KMS/HSM), and model versions.
Nina (Legal): add a question on data residency and audit logs — required for enterprise customers.
Julia (PR): i'll build the Q&A and share in thread. can everyone review by 16:00 PT?
Ravi (Ops): i'll confirm demo smoke results by 07:45 PT tomorrow and upload console screenshots for assets.
Alex (Marketing): asset pack to include: slides (final), exec headshot + bio, bench PDF, Q&A, short quote variants, demo recording. Julia — can you assemble and embargo-send to the pre-brief list?
Julia (PR): yes. embargo email template draft in drive: https://drive.company/launch/embargo_template.md — will send to list after legal ok.
Pressbot: Reminder — embargo window starts 2026-03-24T20:00:00Z. Do not publish before that time.
Sam (Product): tiny ask — can we include a 30s pre-recorded clip of the demo in the assets? avoids live demo risk.
Ravi (Ops): will record and attach by 06:30 PT.
Alex (Marketing): last check — anyone blocking the quote or fact-check?
Nina (Legal): no blockers if wording follows my edit.
Julia (PR): will send final quote + assets at 20:00 PT embargo note. dry run tomorrow 09:30 PT — invite list locked. see you all then :raised_hands:
Alex (Marketing): thanks team, appreciate the quick turnaround.
Julia (PR): cc @Sam @Nina @Ravi — will post final thread update after legal signs off.
